title: Disability and Leadership in Psychology | Dr Sunil Lad, NHS Clinical Director

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你能通过时间交易之外的方式赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖金以及我个人的专属支持套餐，不收取额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆和梅森的慰问品，以及限时的一对一辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: What if the thing that makes you feel different is actually the thing that makes you a better psychologist?
sentences.zh: 如果那个让你感到与众不同的特质，恰恰是让你成为一名更优秀的心理学家的原因呢？

sentences.en: Today, I'm joined by Dr. Sunil Ladd, a consultant counselling psychologist, National NHS Clinical Director,
sentences.zh: 今天，我邀请到了孙尼·拉德博士，他是一位咨询心理学家顾问、国家NHS临床主任，

sentences.en: someone who's spent over 20 years working in prison and mental health settings.
sentences.zh: 一位在监狱和心理健康领域工作了20多年的人。

sentences.en: He also happens to be 3 foot 11 inches tall.
sentences.zh: 他身高恰好是3英尺11英寸。

sentences.en: And in this episode, we're not just talking about height.
sentences.zh: 在这一期节目中，我们不仅仅是在讨论身高。

sentences.en: We're talking about identity, labels, power, difference, and what happens when you grow up in a body the world wasn't built for.
sentences.zh: 我们在讨论身份、标签、权力、差异，以及当你在一个世界并非为你打造的身体中长大时会发生什么。

sentences.en: Because here's the deeper question.
sentences.zh: 因为这里有一个更深层次的问题。

sentences.en: How do you turn lived experience of being othered into leadership and beyond?
sentences.zh: 你如何将作为“局外人”的生活经历转化为领导力及更广阔的成就？

sentences.en: If you've ever felt different, wondered whether this career is for someone like you,
sentences.zh: 如果你曾感到自己与众不同，怀疑这份职业是否适合像你这样的人，

sentences.en: or if you're curious how compassion, therapy, and even yoga can transform suffering into strength, then this conversation might just change how you see yourself.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你好奇同情心、治疗甚至瑜伽如何将苦难转化为力量，那么这次对话可能会改变你看待自己的方式。

sentences.en: If you find it helpful, I'd love it if you comment, liked, and subscribed for more.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得有帮助，我很希望你能评论、点赞并订阅以获取更多内容。

sentences.en: Hi, I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Dr. Sunil Ladd, who is a consultant counselling psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我只想欢迎我们今天的嘉宾孙尼·拉德博士，他是一位咨询心理学家顾问。

sentences.en: Hi, Sunil.
sentences.zh: 嗨，孙尼。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，玛丽安。

sentences.en: Really good to be here with you today.
sentences.zh: 很高兴今天能和你在一起。

sentences.en: Lovely to have you here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: And thank you for connecting with me on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你在领英上和我联系。

sentences.en: And I know we've had some quite interesting conversations, and there's a variety of ideas we had for episodes.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们有过一些相当有趣的对话，我们对这一期节目有很多不同的想法。

sentences.en: And we're actually going to be doing two episodes together.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上将一起做两期节目。

sentences.en: So if people find what we're talking about useful, please do check out our next episode too.
sentences.zh: 所以如果大家觉得我们谈论的内容有用，请务必也来看看我们的下一期节目。

sentences.en: Could I ask you, for anyone who's not watching on YouTube, or who might be visually impaired, or just wants to understand the way that you see yourself and your body,
sentences.zh: 我想问你，对于任何没有在YouTube上观看、可能有视力障碍、或者只是想了解你如何看待自己和身体的人，

sentences.en: could you please describe a little bit about yourself, Sunil?
sentences.zh: 孙尼，你能稍微描述一下你自己吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: So I guess what I'd say is that, you know, people would probably class me as having a disability.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我会说，人们可能会把我归类为有残疾。

sentences.en: So I'm 3'4", 11 in height.
sentences.zh: 我身高3英尺11英寸。

sentences.en: But yeah, so some of my limbs are a bit shorter than others.
sentences.zh: 但是的，我的一些四肢比其他人短一点。

sentences.en: So obviously that has led to some challenges I've faced throughout my life over time.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，这随着时间的推移给我一生中带来了一些挑战。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And I'm aware that there's all sorts of terms that have been used in the past that maybe aren't always
sentences.zh: 我知道过去使用过各种各样的术语，这些术语可能并不总是

sentences.en: that inclusive or kind of very positive or kind of affirming for the person themselves.
sentences.zh: 那么具有包容性，或者对当事人本身非常积极或肯定。

sentences.en: I know before we started recording, I was talking about a lovely book that my sons and I have read, which is by an author called Sinead Burke.
sentences.zh: 我知道在我们开始录音之前，我提到了一本我和儿子们读过的一本好书，作者叫西妮德·伯克。

sentences.en: And it's called Breaking the Mould.
sentences.zh: 书名叫《打破模具》。

sentences.en: And she, I think, is about three and a half foot tall.
sentences.zh: 我想她身高大约三英尺半。

sentences.en: And she really didn't like some of the kind of, some of the labels that had been kind of leveled at her when she was growing up.
sentences.zh: 她真的很不喜欢她在成长过程中被贴上的一些标签。

sentences.en: So she actually, I think, petitioned the Irish government to have the term little person added to the dictionary.
sentences.zh: 所以我想她甚至向爱尔兰政府请愿，将“小人物”这个词收录进字典。

sentences.en: And that's what she likes to use as describing herself.
sentences.zh: 这也是她喜欢用来形容自己的词。

sentences.en: But I'm aware that everybody is unique and should be able to kind of think about what sits right for them.
sentences.zh: 但我知道每个人都是独一无二的，应该能够考虑什么对他们来说是合适的。

sentences.en: Could I ask you what you think about names, about labels, about kind of how you prefer to think and talk about yourself, if that's OK?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我想问问你对名字、对标签、以及对你更喜欢如何看待和谈论自己的看法？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: No, thanks, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 不，谢谢你，玛丽安。

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: And I think we use these all sorts of labels in order to kind of describe ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们使用各种各样的标签来描述自己。

sentences.en: And sometimes that can be quite limiting.
sentences.zh: 有时这可能是相当局限的。

sentences.en: And I think it's really important we think about what's quite freeing.
sentences.zh: 我认为思考什么是相当解放的非常重要。

sentences.en: So I guess, you know, what I would kind of for myself look at is being a short person, because I think for me, that feels like it's a statement of fact, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，我对自己来说会看作是一个矮个子，因为我认为对这我来说，这感觉真的像是一个事实陈述。

sentences.en: I think it's hard, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这很难，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because sometimes we put all sorts of judgments to different words.
sentences.zh: 因为有时我们会对不同的词语附加各种各样的判断。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think I prefer that, really.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我想我真的更喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And today we're kind of thinking about people's experiences, obviously heavily informed by your own experiences.
sentences.zh: 今天我们主要在思考人们的经历，显然这很大程度上受到你自身经历的影响。

sentences.en: But generically, when we're working with people clinically, obviously people can come up against different challenges because of the body they find themselves to be in.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，当我们在临床上与人们合作时，人们显然会因为他们发现自己所在的身体而面临不同的挑战。

sentences.en: But, of course, you know, when we're working with people,
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道，当我们在和人们工作时，

sentences.en: maybe we might be looking at a mother's experience of raising a child who's growing up in a different body or a father or for that matter, siblings.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可能会关注母亲抚养一个在一个不同身体中长大的孩子的经历，或者父亲，或者对父母而言，还有兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: It can be really difficult when you feel like you're getting very different treatment to your siblings, because, you know, we'd might like to think that we exist in isolation,
sentences.zh: 当你觉得你受到的对待与你的兄弟姐妹非常不同时，这可能会非常困难，因为，你知道，我们可能会倾向于认为我们是孤立存在的，

sentences.en: but that isn't the case.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Could I ask you for a little bit about kind of your experiences of growing up in a different body, Sunil?
sentences.zh: 孙尼，能请你谈谈你在一个不同的身体中长大的经历吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I think it's for me, it's kind of thinking about the environment in which I've grown up in, really.
sentences.zh: 所以对我和来说，这其实是关于思考我所成长的环境。

sentences.en: So, yeah, so I guess there were people in my family, so my sister, my dad, with the same condition, whereas my mum wasn't.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的家庭里有人，比如我姐姐、我爸爸，有同样的病情，而我妈妈没有。

sentences.en: And then a larger extended family where there were other people without the condition as well.
sentences.zh: 还有一个更大的大家庭，里面有其他人也没有这种病情。

sentences.en: So I think it's interesting, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以这很有趣，不是吗？

sentences.en: And I think, especially growing up, we develop all sorts of insecurities and I guess that sometimes can be hidden or that can be seen by others.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，特别是在成长过程中，我们会培养出各种各样的不安全感，我想有时这可以被隐藏起来，或者被其他人看到。

sentences.en: But also, I guess when we're growing up, we're often compared to others around us as well, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 但我也认为，当我们成长时，我们经常会被拿来和我们周围的其他人作比较，不是吗？

sentences.en: Whether that's how clever you are or how tall you are or, you know, we're often seen to have either unattractive or attractive qualities where people,
sentences.zh: 无论是你有多聪明，还是你有多高，（你知道）我们经常被视为具有不具吸引力或具有吸引力的品质，而人们，

sentences.en: the environment kind of really promotes us.
sentences.zh: 环境真的在促进我们。

sentences.en: So I guess, you know, everyone will have their unique journey of what that looks like and then people develop their own coping strategies to cope with that,
sentences.zh: 所以我想，每个人都会有他们独特的历程，了解那是什么样的，然后人们会发展出他们自己的应对策略来应对，

sentences.en: whether that's deciding, you know, I think a lot of therapy for me has kind of made me realise that actually that's why I got quite academic.
sentences.zh: 无论是决定——我想我经历的很多治疗让我意识到，其实这就是为什么我变得很有学术精神。

sentences.en: And I got quite motivated in order to compensate about feeling different in a way or feeling not good enough, deciding to use, yeah,
sentences.zh: 我变得很有动力，以此来弥补在某种程度上感到与众不同或感觉不够好的心理，决定去利用，是的，

sentences.en: getting qualifications or working hard as a psychologist or wanting to be a psychologist to kind of compensate against that, really.
sentences.zh: 通过获得资格证书或作为一名心理学家努力工作，或者渴望成为一名心理学家来真正弥补这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And as you're speaking, I'm thinking about, you know,
sentences.zh: 当你在说话的时候，我在想，你知道，

sentences.en: a lot of the identities I might see myself as and the labels that I've either kind of given to myself or others have given to me over the years.
sentences.zh: 我可能视自己为的许多身份，以及这些年来我给自己或别人给我的标签。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think it's always very difficult when you're going from becoming a teenager to a young adult and beyond and, you know, you might be, I want to be,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为当你从青少年过渡到年轻人及以后时，总是非常困难，你知道，你可能是，我想成为，

sentences.en: I want to do this, I want to live independently.
sentences.zh: 我想做这个，我想独立生活。

sentences.en: But I would think maybe with being of smaller stature, maybe people are more likely to infantilise you or speak down to you or, or treat you differently.
sentences.zh: 但我想也许因为身材较矮，人们可能更有可能对你进行幼齿化、对你居高临下或者对你区别对待。

sentences.en: Has that been your experience?
sentences.zh: 这是你的经历吗？

sentences.en: I think it's been really interesting in terms of especially, it definitely has been my experience.
sentences.zh: 我认为特别是在这方面非常有趣，这绝对是我的经历。

sentences.en: And I think it's really interesting to see the different spheres in which I travel and I, especially when I do training,
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得看到我所经历的不同领域非常有趣，特别是当我做培训时，

sentences.en: I kind of talk about the difference and recognising the difference of, for example,
sentences.zh: 我往往会谈论这种差异，并认识到这种差异，例如，

sentences.en: how people might see me just as I'm shopping in Sainsbury's compared to when I'm in a meeting as the lead psychologist in the whole team, for example, or, you know,
sentences.zh: 人们在森斯伯里超市购物时怎么看我，与我在会议上作为整个团队的首席心理学家时有何不同，或者，你知道，

sentences.en: walking into prisons with my role.
sentences.zh: 以我的角色走进监狱。

sentences.en: So, so I think there is something about, again, how do we use different labels or, or, you know, what do people initially see, which means that they might get treated as less than,
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这里确实有些关于我们如何使用不同的标签，或者人们最初看到的是什么，这意味着他们可能会被当作低人一等对待，

sentences.en: because I think automatically you do, you do get that.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为你自然而然地会得到那样的对待。

sentences.en: But I think there's also something about how you might carry yourself as well.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为，这里还有一些关于你如何举止自若的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I think for me, even just going to Sainsbury's, for example, and trying not to hold any shame, when I've got to ask for something that's on a high shelf,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为对我来说，甚至只是去森斯伯里购物，并努力不抱有任何羞耻感，当我不得不要求够到高架子上的东西时，

sentences.en: whereas actually, that was a journey in itself, I think, for me, kind of feeling really embarrassed at first to ask someone.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，对我来说这本身就是一段旅程，一开始向别人开口请求会感到非常尴尬。

sentences.en: And I think that that takes a bit of time.
sentences.zh: 我认为这需要一点时间。

sentences.en: And I think maybe that's why I also trained as a psychologist to learn these skills of why I help other people as well.
sentences.zh: 也许这也是为什么我也训练成为一名心理学家，去学习这些技能，为什么我也能帮助别人。

sentences.en: But I think it's important to think about actually, yes, the world might not be equipped, but at the same time, I think, you know, as I,
sentences.zh: 但我认为重要的是要思考，是的，世界可能没有做好准备，但与此同时，我认为，正如我，

sentences.en: as I'm someone who practice compassion focused therapy, one of the things that I often think about is where is the wisdom?
sentences.zh: 正如我是一个践行专注疗法的人，我经常思考的一件事是：智慧在哪里？

sentences.en: What wisdom, what wisdom can I use to apply to kind of really look at this rather than get caught up in suffering?
sentences.zh: 我可以运用什么智慧来真正看待这个问题，而不是陷入痛苦之中？

sentences.en: But I guess, in a way, probably a lot of those experiences throughout my life have led to suffering, in a way, you know, being talked down to, but also,
sentences.zh: 但我想，在某种程度上，我一生中的很多经历可能确实导致了痛苦，在某种程度上，你知道，被居高临下地对待，但同时，

sentences.en: I think maybe things are changing.
sentences.zh: 我想事情可能正在改变。

sentences.en: I think people are really aware of these things now, people are, yeah, more conscious to not be disrespectful, in a way, compared to probably, when I was growing up,
sentences.zh: 我认为人们现在真的很意识到这些事情，人们，是的，更有意识不去不尊重人，与可能在我成长的时候相比，

sentences.en: whereas people would be quite, obviously, there's probably cultural and kind of intergenerational messages, whereas I think older people would be quite okay with making a joke,
sentences.zh: 当时人们会相当——显然可能存在文化和代际信息，而我认为年长的人开个玩笑会觉得挺正常的，

sentences.en: whereas younger people, I think, would probably be a lot more uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 而年轻人可能会觉得要尴尬得多。

sentences.en: And I think there's something about one of the things I recognise, is that actually, sometimes people can feel really uncomfortable,
sentences.zh: 我认为我意识到的事情之一是，实际上，有时人们会感到非常不舒服，

sentences.en: and that's when they decide to make some kind of joke, because that's their way of trying to talk about it, but not talk about it as well.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们决定开某种玩笑的时候，因为那是他们试图谈论它但又同时避而不谈的方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think, you know, I often, I hope people are getting better, and getting kinder, certainly in person, but keyboard warriors are not always that kind, and trolls,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为，我常常——希望人们能变得更好、更友善，当然在现实中是这样，但键盘侠并不总是那么友善，还有网络喷子，

sentences.en: and I don't know if you follow the account of, it's a couple called, I think they're called Squirmy and Grub, and one of them is in a wheelchair,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否关注过这样一个账号，是一对夫妇，我想他们叫Squirmy and Grub，其中一个人坐轮椅，

sentences.en: and I think has some sort of kind of muscle condition, where the muscle tone is affected.
sentences.zh: 我想还有某种肌肉疾病，肌肉张力受到了影响。

sentences.en: But the female is kind of of normal stature, and walks ably, and people, I mean, you know, that's their brand now, so I think that's what they do, they talk about campaigning,
sentences.zh: 但女性身材正常，能够正常行走，人们——我的意思是，你知道，这现在是他们的品牌了，所以我想这就是他们所做的，他们谈论倡导活动，

sentences.en: and about kind of, yeah, how it's okay to be in a relationship, and loving sexual relationship with someone that might look very different to you,
sentences.zh: 关于，是的，身处一段恋爱关系中是没问题的，与一个看起来可能和你非常不同的人发生充满爱意的性关系也是没问题的，

sentences.en: and that people will really struggle, I think, to see that that's a genuine relationship, or that it might say something about her, if she finds him sexually attractive,
